title: Yummy Whipped Jamaican Fry Skillet
description: A rich and creamy skillet dish with a twist of Jamaican flavors, featuring whipping cream and low-glycemic-friendly ingredients. Perfect for a lazy Sunday breakfast.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the Cajun seasoning and Jamaican allspice, and let it cook for 1 minute.
Add the sliced sweet potato and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until it starts to brown.
Add the fried plantains to the skillet and stir to combine with the sweet potato.
Pour in the whipping cream and stir to combine with the plantains and sweet potato.
Reduce heat to medium-low and let it simmer for 2-3 minutes, or until the sauce thickens slightly.
Stir in the chopped cilantro and season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the skillet hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
Let the skillet rest for 2-3 minutes before serving to allow the cream to thicken.
